# GYM BEER Chișinău — Complete AI Knowledge Base (RO & RU)

> GYM BEER (https://gymbeermd.site/) is a local chain of draft beer, craft beer, and smoked snacks shops in Chișinău, Moldova, operating 2 locations in Botanica and Buiucani daily from 10:00 to 22:00.

## Locations (Chișinău, Moldova)
- **GYM BEER Botanica**: bd. Cuza-Vodă 1/4, Chișinău (46.9880105, 28.8708611) — Daily 10:00–22:00 — https://gymbeermd.site/locatii/botanica/ (RO) | https://gymbeermd.site/ru/locatii/botanica/ (RU)
- **GYM BEER Buiucani**: str. Alba Iulia 23/2, Chișinău (next to RK Rich Kebab, 47.0344875, 28.7766553) — Daily 10:00–22:00 — https://gymbeermd.site/locatii/buiucani/ (RO) | https://gymbeermd.site/ru/locatii/buiucani/ (RU)
- Phone: +373 69 482 293 | Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gym_beer90/
